Coffee bars often line up several of these for flavoured syrups, while restaurant kitchens keep them for soy sauce, honey or salad dressing near the pass. The dark head looks tidy on a back-bar shelf or a white counter alike.

KKA0373-SSSD2.care: Very thick sauces, or ones with grains or residue, may not come through the pumps, so strain or thin them first. Wash the plungers with soap and water, rinse the inner jars, and wipe the steel shell dry after each service.

KKA0373-SSSD2.meta: Kitchenary Kart double steel-pump sauce dispenser with two 2000ml compartments in a stainless steel housing for ketchup, mayo and dessert sauces.
conflicts: Document says Tank Material: Stainless Steel (name 'SS Tank'); photos show removable white inner jars inside the steel shell (material not labelled). Copy calls the outer shell steel and does not name the jar material.
